dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Linear narrowing of the visible body mass from the upper frame toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical without visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity pixel distribution across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient at the lateral interface between the white epidermal surface and the dark water medium.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized green-hue chromatic refraction at the submerged distal tip of the visible white structure.
